tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the app grid and the main scroll area. Text on it: text, muted.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Topbar, sidebar, ticket panel, cards, modals, inputs and resting buttons.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Second-level fill: table row hover, stat tiles, server cards, suggested-question buttons, the head and foot of the live queue.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: panel dividers, card and input borders, table rows. Decorative only (1.25:1 on surface), never the sole sign of a control.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-2 and bubble (14:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, table headers, resting nav items and icons, on bg, surface and surface-2 (4.5:1 light, 5.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one interactive hue: primary buttons, links, active nav and tab, focus border, selected rows' text, the logo. As text on surface, bg or accent-soft (5:1+).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: active nav, selected table row, segmented and tab 'on', badge counts, the focus halo.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent fill (primary button, ribbon, my chat bubble, the ringer). White in light (6:1), dark ink in dark (6.5:1 on the lighter dark accent).

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: App chrome: the topbar on every screen. Navy in both themes; text on it is chrome-text, chrome-muted and chrome-accent.

tokens.name: chrome-2
tokens.usage: The sidebar and hover fills inside the chrome.

tokens.name: chrome-3
tokens.usage: Hover and active fills on the sidebar.

tokens.name: chrome-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and control borders inside the chrome.

tokens.name: chrome-text
tokens.usage: Primary text on chrome and chrome-2.

tokens.name: chrome-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and resting icons on chrome and chrome-2.

tokens.name: chrome-accent
tokens.usage: The interactive hue inside the chrome: active nav, links, the logo, focus. Labels on a chrome-accent fill use chrome.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px outside the control (inset inside the sidebar, tabs, segmented buttons, lists and table rows, which clip). 5:1 or better on every surface and tint in both themes. On the inverted primary desk card the ring uses surface instead.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Resolved, healthy, passed: status pills, OK dots and LEDs, score ring A/B, the ✓ in feedback lists. As text on good-soft (4.63:1 light, 8.8:1 dark) or the surfaces.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind good text: resolved pill, live call bar, active session pill, low priority.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: SLA due soon, on hold, voicemail, degraded nodes, high meters. As text on warn-soft or surface (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warn text and behind high and medium priority badges; the ringing-call row on the live queue.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Breach, error, locked, penalties: SLA breach, reopened, critical alerts, the danger button, the ✕ in feedback. As text on bad-soft or surface (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind bad text: critical priority, reopened pill, critical alert, late call bar.

tokens.name: on-bad
tokens.usage: Label on a bad fill (the danger button). White in light (5.6:1), dark ink in dark (6.7:1).

tokens.name: crit
tokens.usage: Priority P1 (Critical) text. On bad-soft (5.7:1 light, 6:1 dark).

tokens.name: high
tokens.usage: Priority P2 (High) text. On warn-soft: 4.67:1 light, 6.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: med
tokens.usage: Priority P3 (Medium) text; 'waiting on approval/vendor' statuses. On warn-soft: 4.62:1 light, 10:1 dark.

tokens.name: low
tokens.usage: Priority P4 (Low) text. On good-soft: 4.61:1 light, 8.8:1 dark.

tokens.name: bubble
tokens.usage: Requester chat bubbles and calendar job blocks. Text on it: text.

tokens.name: p1
tokens.usage: Landing alias for Critical: the queue's priority bar, the hero's <em>, the alert dot on the timeline.

tokens.name: p2
tokens.usage: Landing alias for High: the ringing-call icon and 'Ringing' label.

tokens.name: p3
tokens.usage: Landing alias for Medium.

tokens.name: p4
tokens.usage: Landing alias for Low.

tokens.name: int
tokens.usage: Coordinator mode: internal-note chat bubbles (never seen by the client). Text on it: text.

tokens.name: int-border
tokens.usage: Coordinator mode: the border of an internal-note bubble.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: Coordinator mode: the diagonal hatch on off-shift cells of the dispatch board.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal overlay behind a dialog, both themes.

tokens.name: toast-bg
tokens.usage: Toast background, the same in both themes. Text: white (15.9:1).

tokens.name: toast-info
tokens.usage: Toast left edge, default (accent) tone.

tokens.name: toast-good
tokens.usage: Toast left edge, success.

tokens.name: toast-bad
tokens.usage: Toast left edge, error or penalty.

tokens.name: toast-warn
tokens.usage: Toast left edge, information that needs attention.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: Landing-page terminal snippet ground, both themes.

tokens.name: term-fg
tokens.usage: Landing terminal text on term-bg (12:1).

tokens.name: term-dim
tokens.usage: Landing terminal prompt on term-bg (7:1).

tokens.name: term-ok
tokens.usage: Landing terminal success output on term-bg.

tokens.name: term-err
tokens.usage: Landing terminal error output on term-bg.

tokens.name: console-bg
tokens.usage: In-game command prompt ground, both themes. Slightly darker than term-bg; the two are separate in the source.

tokens.name: console-fg
tokens.usage: In-game command prompt output on console-bg (14:1).

tokens.name: console-prompt
tokens.usage: In-game command prompt 'C:\>' prefix on console-bg (9:1).

tokens.name: desktop-1
tokens.usage: Simulated Windows wallpaper gradient, first stop (135deg).

tokens.name: desktop-2
tokens.usage: Simulated wallpaper gradient, middle stop at 55%.

tokens.name: desktop-3
tokens.usage: Simulated wallpaper gradient, last stop.

tokens.name: taskbar
tokens.usage: Simulated Windows taskbar over the wallpaper; white text.

tokens.name: popup-bg
tokens.usage: Adware pop-up on the simulated desktop.

tokens.name: popup-fg
tokens.usage: Adware pop-up text on popup-bg (12.8:1).

tokens.name: popup-border
tokens.usage: Adware pop-up 2px border.

tokens.name: ransom-bg
tokens.usage: Ransom note on the simulated desktop.

tokens.name: ransom-fg
tokens.usage: Ransom note text on ransom-bg (8.2:1).

tokens.name: ransom-border
tokens.usage: Ransom note 2px border.

tokens.name: grade-a
tokens.usage: Report grade tile A, both themes; white letter.

tokens.name: grade-b
tokens.usage: Report grade tile B; white letter.

tokens.name: grade-c
tokens.usage: Report grade tile C; white letter.

tokens.name: grade-d

tokens.name: grade-f
